description: This file implements the 'nrppa_ue_context_list' class, managing UE contexts including creation, updating, removal, and ID allocation within a 3GPP-based radio system.

classes.name: nrppa_ue_context_list
classes.description: Manages a list of UE contexts, providing methods for adding, updating, removing, and allocating IDs.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a UE context with the given UE index exists.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Accesses the UE context by UE index, asserting its existence.

methods.name: add_ue
methods.description: Creates and adds a new UE context with specified identifiers and notifiers.

methods.name: update_ue_index
methods.description: Updates the UE context's index, replacing the old with a new one.

methods.name: remove_ue_context
methods.description: Removes a UE context by UE index.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of UE contexts managed.

methods.name: allocate_ran_ue_meas_id
methods.description: Allocates the next available RAN UE measurement ID, ensuring no duplicates.

methods.name: increase_next_ran_ue_meas_id
methods.description: Increments or resets the next RAN UE measurement ID.
